mapper.select: SELECT root.project_id AS projectId, SUM(CASE WHEN p.parent_project_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS childCount, MAX(CASE WHEN p.parent_project_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS selfMatches FROM project p JOIN project root ON root.project_id=COALESCE(p.parent_project_id,p.project_id) AND root.parent_project_id IS NULL AND root.is_delete=0 WHERE GROUP BY root.project_id, root.created_time ORDER BY root.created_time DESC, root.project_id DESC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT root.project_id) AS totalCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.parent_project_id IS NOT NULL THEN p.project_id END) AS childCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.project_status=1 THEN root.project_id END) AS processingCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.project_status=2 THEN root.project_id END) AS pendingAcceptanceCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.project_status=4 THEN root.project_id END) AS completedCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.parent_project_id IS NULL THEN c.amount ELSE 0 END),0) AS rootContractAmount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.parent_project_id IS NOT NULL THEN c.amount ELSE 0 END),0) AS childContractAmount FROM project p JOIN project root ON root.project_id=COALESCE(p.parent_project_id,p.project_id) AND root.parent_project_id IS NULL AND root.is_delete=0 LEFT JOIN (SELECT project_id, SUM(contract_amount) AS amount FROM contract WHERE is_delete=0 GROUP BY project_id) c ON c.project_id=p.project_id WHERE
